description: Ragdolls (WP 10.2) in the box: box:ragdoll's first cycle and the start of its second, with no input. The first partner, struck from the front, falls onto its back and gets up from it; the second, struck from behind, onto its face; the third is launched up and a little east; the fourth is killed and lies until the cycle stands it up at 6 s; at 8 s every partner stands on its spot again and the next cycle's first blow lands.
